title: Roots, Matrices, and Invariants
question: Which quantities remain fixed as polynomial roots move?
summary: Relate complex roots, Vieta identities, Newton sums, companion matrices, traces, determinants, spectral transformations, and typed units. A chosen matrix has a mathematical spectrum; that spectrum becomes physical only when a physical model derives the operator.

caveats: A mathematical spectrum is not a physical spectrum without a derived operator.
